# Checkpoint

Resolved the scalar-string to `[]string` decoding regression in `internal/config/config.go`.

- The decode hook applies only to string sources and exact `[]string` targets.
- It splits on Unicode whitespace and commas, ignores repeated/leading/trailing separators, and returns a non-nil empty slice for blank input.
- Updated the advanced config fixture to exercise whitespace-separated origins through both YAML and environment loading; added direct hook coverage for empty input and unchanged non-string/sequence cases.
- Verification: `go test ./internal/config` passed; `git diff --check` passed.

+func stringToSliceHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFunc {
+	return func(f, t reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if f.Kind() != reflect.String || t != reflect.TypeOf([]string{}) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		value, ok := data.(string)
+		if !ok {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		values := strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
+			return r == ',' || unicode.IsSpace(r)
+		})
+		if values == nil {
+			values = []string{}
+		}
+
+		return values, nil
+	}
+}

+func TestStringToSliceDecodeHook(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		input  interface{}
+		target interface{}
+		want   interface{}
+	}{
+		{
+			name:   "whitespace separators and surrounding whitespace",
+			input:  "  foo.com\tbar.com\nbaz.com  ",
+			target: []string{},
+			want:   []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "comma compatibility",
+			input:  "foo.com,bar.com",
+			target: []string{},
+			want:   []string{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "empty input",
+			input:  "",
+			target: []string{},
+			want:   []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "whitespace only input",
+			input:  " \t\n ",
+			target: []string{},
+			want:   []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "sequence source is unchanged",
+			input:  []interface{}{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+			target: []string{},
+			want:   []interface{}{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "non string source is unchanged",
+			input:  42,
+			target: []string{},
+			want:   42,
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "other target type is unchanged",
+			input:  "foo.com bar.com",
+			target: []int{},
+			want:   "foo.com bar.com",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := mapstructure.DecodeHookExec(
+				stringToSliceHookFunc(),
+				reflect.ValueOf(tt.input),
+				reflect.ValueOf(tt.target),
+			)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}
